explanation: The statement is entirely phrased in TauCeti-specific notions: `IsCombinatorialBall` (TauCeti/.../CombinatorialManifold/Basic.lean), `openStarRealization` (TauCeti/.../Realization/Star/Basic.lean), `vertex K v` (TauCeti/.../Realization/Basic.lean) and the link `link K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex {v}`. Searching Mathlib for `IsCombinatorialBall`, `openStarRealization`, `geometricLink`, `openStar`, `vertex` in the simplicial-complex sense, and for `EuclideanHalfSpace` turns up only Mathlib's generic `EuclideanHalfSpace` model space (Geometry/Manifold/Instances/Real.lean) and the unrelated abstract simplicial complex API (AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean); there is no statement about a chart/homeomorphism from a vertex star of a simplicial complex onto an open half-ball, nor any notion of combinatorial ball or link ball, so there is no Mathlib declaration to instantiate or duplicate. The current proof instead builds the chart from the library's own `exists_homeomorph_openStar_halfBall` via `OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans` and `lift_openEmbedding`.
